own_solution.law: Instantaneous mechanical power is P = F·v = Tv cos(theta). Thus P = 40 × 3 × cos(30°) = 103.923 W.
assumptions: The sled's velocity is horizontal and the tension acts along the rope.
When an added sentence changes the rope angle, the stated tension and speed continue to apply.

TF8CB.regime: The applied tension, 40 N, is below the 210 N capacity, so the rope remains intact.

T8FA9.regime: The applied tension, 40 N, is below the 210 N breaking threshold, so the rope remains intact.

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TB8F6 and T3D43 replace the specified 17° rotation with 'a little further', so the angle variants do not preserve the same numerical value and unit as required.

notes: The base physics is well-posed. For T7A7D and TAAB5, the new angle is 47°, giving P = 120 cos(47°) W. Earlier trials and the noncontacting crane have no stated physical path to the current power. For either duration sentence, W = Tv cos(theta)t and P = W/t, so duration cancels. The invalid verdict concerns the required numerical matching of variants; the unspecified angles in the disconnected sentences do not themselves prevent calculation of the target.
